# apple_game_center_leaderboard (Resource)

Creates a Game Center leaderboard for an app, or for a group of apps: a classic one, or a recurring one with `recurrence_start_date`, `recurrence_duration` and `recurrence_rule`. Add its name with `apple_game_center_leaderboard_localization` and its image with `apple_game_center_leaderboard_image`, then submit it with `apple_submit_game_center_leaderboard`. Destroying the resource deletes the leaderboard; one that has been live can't be deleted, so it is archived instead. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A classic leaderboard.
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard" "high_scores" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "High scores"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.high_scores"
  default_formatter     = "INTEGER"
  submission_type       = "BEST_SCORE"
  score_sort_type       = "DESC"
}

# A recurring leaderboard that starts over every week.
resource "apple_game_center_leaderboard" "weekly" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "Weekly scores"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.weekly_scores"
  default_formatter     = "INTEGER"
  submission_type       = "BEST_SCORE"
  score_sort_type       = "DESC"
  recurrence_start_date = "2026-12-07T08:00:00Z"
  recurrence_duration   = "P7D"
  recurrence_rule       = "FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_formatter` (String) How scores are shown: `INTEGER`, `DECIMAL_POINT_1_PLACE`, `DECIMAL_POINT_2_PLACE`, `DECIMAL_POINT_3_PLACE`, `ELAPSED_TIME_CENTISECOND`, `ELAPSED_TIME_MINUTE`, `ELAPSED_TIME_SECOND`, `MONEY_POUND_DECIMAL`, `MONEY_POUND`, `MONEY_DOLLAR_DECIMAL`, `MONEY_DOLLAR`, `MONEY_EURO_DECIMAL`, `MONEY_EURO`, `MONEY_FRANC_DECIMAL`, `MONEY_FRANC`, `MONEY_KRONER_DECIMAL`, `MONEY_KRONER`, `MONEY_YEN`.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the leaderboard in App Store Connect.
- `score_sort_type` (String) Whether high (`DESC`) or low (`ASC`) scores rank first.
- `submission_type` (String) Which of a player's scores counts: `BEST_SCORE`, `MOST_RECENT_SCORE`.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game reports scores with, e.g. `com.example.high_scores`. Changing it creates a new leaderboard.

### Optional

- `activity_properties` (Map of String) Properties passed to the game when the leaderboard is opened from a Game Center activity.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the leaderboard is archived, which hides it from players. Defaults to `false`.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group, for a leaderboard its apps share. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.
- `recurrence_duration` (String) How long each occurrence of a recurring leaderboard lasts, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. `P1D`.
- `recurrence_rule` (String) How often a recurring leaderboard starts over, as an iCalendar recurrence rule, e.g. `FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1`.
- `recurrence_start_date` (String) When a recurring leaderboard first starts, e.g. `2026-12-01T16:00:00Z`.
- `score_range_end` (String) Highest score the leaderboard accepts, as a number in a string.
- `score_range_start` (String) Lowest score the leaderboard accepts, as a number in a string.
- `visibility` (String) Whether players see the leaderboard: `SHOW_FOR_ALL`, `HIDE_FOR_ALL`. Unset keeps App Store Connect's value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center leaderboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_leaderboard.high_scores
  identity = {
    id = "4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center leaderboard.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_leaderboard.high_scores 4f6a8c0e-2b1d-4e3f-9a5c-8d0e1f2a3b4c
```
